import numpy as np
# eta_k = max over units a mod 3^k of |sum_{b>=1} 2^{-b} e(a 2^b / 3^k)|
print("k   eta_k      3*eta_k^2   eta_k*sqrt(3)")
prods=1.0; cum=[]
for k in range(1,13):
    Q=3**k; P=2*3**(k-1)
    # 2^b mod Q cycles with period P; closed form: sum over r=1..P of 2^{-r} zeta^{2^r} / (1-2^{-P})
    pw=[pow(2,r,Q) for r in range(1,P+1)]
    best=0
    units=[a for a in range(1,Q) if a%3] if k<=7 else None
    if units is None:
        # sample units for large k (orbit symmetry: a and a*2^j give same |S|; a -> -a conj)

        g=2
        # representatives of units modulo the action a ~ a*2^j (orbit size P) => # classes = phi(Q)/P = 1? phi=2*3^{k-1}=P => single orbit per sign!? phi(Q)=2*3^{k-1}=P exactly => all units are powers of 2 mod Q!
        units={1}
    for a in units:
        S=sum(2.0**(-r)*np.exp(2j*np.pi*((a*pw[r-1])%Q)/Q) for r in range(1,P+1))/(1-2.0**(-P))
        v=abs(S)
        if v>best: best=v
    prods*=3*best**2; cum.append(prods)
    print(f"{k:2d}  {best:.6f}  {3*best**2:.6f}  {best*np.sqrt(3):.6f}")
print("\ncumulative prod_{j<=k} (3 eta_j^2):", [f"{x:.4f}" for x in cum])
